property: A phone relays under the default condition unless the owner's override says otherwise.
The floor of three is tested over the dealt layers, and the liveness of answering relays is a separate refusal.
A route reaches a peer only by its owner's own handing, and a referral carries only routes whose owners offered relay.
Every bound a mailbox cites resolves to a stated number.
A node is dealt as a relay only if it is owner-bound under a root in the genesis charter set.
A serve seat's functions in the tier are one closed list that includes relaying and the federation-scope mailbox.
At most one return per owner per period is counted, however many nodes the owner has.
The door admits a share to any serve seat, and an honest sender uses only the pair drawn for the period.
A published census row carries the exact field sum, and rounding never changes a stored value.
Every quantity a gate reads is a quantity the census publishes.
Every self and family write is sealed under a fresh key, so a removal needs no rotation.
A wrap's recipient is always an occurrence encryption key and never an identity key.
At community and affiliations a joiner reads no earlier epoch, and at self and family admission re-keys the walk.
An acceptance is admitted only when its signer resolves to the invitee, and a node gives none of its own.
An occurrence binding is admitted only when signed by the identity or a current occurrence of it.
A seated serve node's key is rebound only by the holders cosigning at the charter's M, never by one holder or the node itself.
A device is added by one approval that signs two rows after the owner compares a code their own node derived.
An unowned node signs nothing but a device-join request.
Each FedCode kind maps to exactly one value of one named vocabulary.
No wrapped key is admitted under the v1 suite on any axis.
A withdraws or recants that names a key grant is refused.
A Dmca512 withhold reverses at ten days counted from each holder's tombstone.
Only its signer retracts a holding claim.
A peering with a withdrawn half never folds as ratified.
No replication list entry has scope self.
An exempt family is admitted with or without a tail.
An ungated family may be admitted without a registry row, and a gated family never.
Every gated stem of the manifest fits the definition of gated, and an unclaimed leaf under it is refused.
No read rule of the substrate redacts a capacity row.
A keyless family root charters and confers by a member's row whose signature set reaches the family's protocol.
A capacity row is admitted only under the scope member of a granted consent row, and no fold reads a consent scope dimension row.
Dissolution is reached with no deciding seat left, so it is a verdict of the fold and needs no signed row.
Every value the affiliation record admits belongs to exactly one named member.
In a body with one deciding seat an act against a member is admitted only with a countersign from outside that seat, and otherwise stands as a proposal.
A pinned name confers no trust until it resolves against an anchored fingerprint.
A charter change carries on a strict majority of the standing roster, and only a fresh genesis needs every holder.
A fresh node's pairs for every canonical come only from the bundle, and any other way pins one link.
No trust or un-trust edge of a node is honoured unless its owner signed it.
A ballot with no votes has no winner and stays open, and no node's clock closes or reopens it.
Every member is a candidate, and a track record orders the ballot and never excludes.
A moderator's act is applied only if a live holder of the role exists at apply time, whatever ended the last one.
The accountable-root predicate holds for an adult user key that is not steward-bound and for a steward-bound key, so a seated holder always satisfies it.
A head and its witnessed descendant are never read as equivocation.
The witness quorum is counted only over the witnesses the charter lists.
A witness's first cosignature carries an empty prior and is checked for descent against the genesis head.
An identity occurrence never makes a key steward-bound, and the steward fold reads owner-bindings alone.
The steward predicate is membership of a set that has at most one member.
Custody is single-valued while agency delegation may have several parents.
A halt fires with no window before it, and the fuse window follows it.
A row from an evicted key is admitted only when dated within W before the eviction.
A live roster key's row is admitted at any signed instant, and that reach is listed among the residuals.
A replication target above the audience is read as the audience and never refused.
A node outside the grant's cohorts holds no grant, and no deny row exists on the wire.
An owner's grant for their own node is held at self and publishes no cohort id.
An unclaimed node is in no cohort's audience and serves infrastructure only.
No roster is checked for a licensing authority, and a licence is honoured only through the reader's own edge.
A licence is admitted when its signature set meets the affiliation's protocol, a one-member protocol included.
A relay that re-serialises changes no signing byte.
An intake refusal made before the parse completes carries the same token as the canonical-bytes refusal.
An envelope of exactly 1 MiB of canonical bytes is admitted and one byte more is refused.
A build manifest has one signer rule: the pipeline that built it, judged by the reader.
No federation-scope row names an unannounced node.
An ordinary row about a subject is removed only by an admitted withdraws, and no node-local purge removes it.
Every revocation of an occurrence has a named signer, the key that could sign the occurrence.
No node outside the audience holds a cohort's bytes, and carrying a sealed frame is not holding.
The set of refusal tokens is closed and every token the text names is in it.
The key record's member set is closed and holds no hardware class outside the attestation evidence.
A deferral trigger stops the action in question and leaves the agent running on everything else.
A subject named by canonical hash withdraws under rule 3, through its proxy.
A private cohort is invisible to an outsider who holds no envelope of it.
Every member the text names is a member of the signed-object table.
Ownership moves by withdraw-then-rebind or supersede-then-rebind, and at most one live owner-binding holds at any instant.
A cycle of delegation edges is refused, and a cycle of acceptance edges is walked once.
An identity occurrence never makes a key steward-bound, and the steward fold reads owner-bindings alone.
A node takes part in normal operation only after the claim that binds it to its owner.
A per-item replication target is available at every tier but the anonymous one.
No serve seat is held by a node whose owner has not announced it.
A minor's node never carries an owner-binding at federation scope.
The roster of an encrypted tier is never discoverable, and only a public room is found, by its listing row.
A custody report is withdrawn only by the device that signed it.
A score is admitted only if it lies in the polarity class the registry gives its family.
A row of any attestation type may carry a reference to another row, with composer meaning on the three composers alone.
A holding claim's scope is one of the five the rule lists, and any other is refused.
A row about a person reaches that person, the author's self note alone excepted, and a duty-holder's record shows at least its existence, kind, consequence and answerer.
Every signed member has exactly one row that gives its meaning.
A withdrawal reaches forward only, so a copy taken before it is never recalled.
Every reserved role is a delegation edge resolved against a root the reader trusts.
No consumer policy walks a chain of more than five hops.
A bounded-scope row names only keys it reaches, and is otherwise refused.
Removing a trust entry never clears a halt already latched.
A subject with authority to withdraw a row may have no reach over it when the row is the author's self note.
A deletion window is judged on the row that carries it, and a breach is that row still present after its deadline.
A private cohort is invisible to an outsider who holds no envelope of it.
A revoked stance bounds grants in the consent fold and retires no row.
A self-asserted binding of a key to a hash never admits that key's withdraws against a row naming the hash.
A row moves to a peer when the peer pulls it and its audience names the peer, or unasked under a replication grant.
An absent witness quorum reads as zero, which is witnessed mode off.
A key grant is a scores row of the key-grant family, one per recipient, with no discriminator of its own.
A withdraws is admitted on any one path of the admission table and on no other.
A widening is admitted by exactly one rule, so no state exists where the declared protocol admits and the policy row refuses.
No declared protocol admits on fewer voices than the floor at any roster size.
The base of an act cosigned under a declared protocol is the standing roster.
A community removal carries on at least two voices at every base of two or more.
A build manifest has one signer rule: the pipeline that built it, judged by the reader.
